pastTxsConclusion.en: The vault's owner and curator Safes made all 69 allocator transactions: 2 fit exactly, 10 moved USDC into two unregistered Morini markets, 45 used an adapter the vault has since removed, 10 ran one or three items, and 2 withdrew and put in different amounts. The last fitting shape is from August 2026.

text.en: No card for this vault can execute now. At block 26485309 a 1-unit `deallocate` from the owner Safe, itself an allocator, reverted for all four registered markets, and `allocate` reverted with ZeroAbsoluteCap for all but usdc-usp-86. Nearly all 756,078 USDC is in two unregistered Morini markets.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 的 card 現在都執行不了。區塊 26485309，用 owner Safe（它是 allocator）試 1 單位：四個登記的市場 `deallocate` 全部 revert；`allocate` 除了 usdc-usp-86 都因 ZeroAbsoluteCap revert。756,078 USDC 幾乎全在兩個沒登記的 Morini 市場。

recommendation.en: Do not build a card for this vault until it has funds in a registered market and a cap in another one.
recommendation.zh-TW: 等 vault 在某個登記的市場有錢、另一個登記的市場有上限，再建 card。

text.en: This vault is not listed on the Morpho app (Morpho API `listed` = false). Its monthly samples rose from 0.83 million USDC in 2026-02 to 5.21 million in 2026-03 and fell to 0.76 million now. 68 addresses hold shares; the largest has 30.52% and the top 10 hold 97.03%.

recommendation.en: Only this vault's allocator uses this. It is small, shrinking and concentrated, so read To review again before signing.
recommendation.zh-TW: 只有這個 vault 的 allocator 會用到；它小、在縮水、持有人集中，簽之前再看一次待確認。

text.en: Moving funds has no timelock; it takes effect right after signing.

title.en: Which registered market has a cap
title.zh-TW: 哪個登記的市場有上限

text.en: Only usdc-usp-86 can receive funds: its caps are unlimited, and deposits go there. The absolute and relative caps of usdc-usp-915, usdc-cbbtc-86 and usdc-weeth-86 are 0 (block 26485299). Even after new deposits reach usdc-usp-86, they have no other registered market to go to until the curator raises a cap, which has a 3-day timelock.
text.zh-TW: 只有 usdc-usp-86 能收錢：上限沒有限制，存款也進這裡。usdc-usp-915、usdc-cbbtc-86、usdc-weeth-86 的絕對和相對上限都是 0（區塊 26485299）。就算新存款進了 usdc-usp-86，也沒有別的登記市場可搬，要等 curator 提高上限，timelock 是 3 天。

title.en: The owner Safe gets fee shares

text.en: If the signing Safe is the owner, it may get vault shares: the 10% performance fee is paid to the owner Safe 0xEB4Af6fA3AFA08B10d593EC8fF87efB03BC04645 when interest accrues. The curator Safe 0x6788c8ad65E85CCa7224a0B46D061EF7D81F9Da5 is not a fee recipient; both are allocators.
